item.tib: shog dril gsum pa sgrub pa lam 'jug rlung sems dbang bsdud rlung sbyong snang ba sku ru lam khyer grags pa gsung du lam khyer dran pa thugs su laMm khyer
item.coloph: bdag 'dra tshe dbang rig 'dzin gyis snyan rgyad zab mo'i cha lag tu/ shin tu zab pas yig chung rnams/ tshig nyung don che gnad zab yi ger bkod nas gter du sbas/ phyi ma skal ldan rigs kyi bu/ nga'i byin rlabs gcig dang spod/ des kyang lo gsum rtags kyis (brtag gyis) la/ lung bstan slob bu tshogs la spel/ 'gro don spang la me mched bzhin/ bstan pa dar zhing rgyas par 'gyur/ sa ma ya/ rgya rgya rgya sku gsung thugs kyi rgya yod do//
